subject: Staffing & constraints — invariant explanations
body: Lucia — staffing and constraints. Allocations for the heavy month: Bilal Novak is committed at 60% to this project for May 2026 — he owns the covariate pipelines (X,H assembly and the W@epoch extraction, which is the fiddly one). Around him: Linnea 40% (meta-model training), Fumiko 30% (eval design), Vera 25% (infra), Yusuf 15% (advisory). Compute: the meta-models are small; the cost is I/O — the zoo's weight snapshots are ~2 TB and the train/test instance splits multiply fast (base models × samples per model), so we're asking Corpus for a fast-scratch mirror rather than GPU reservations. Titan best-effort covers training. One process note: if the audit prototype is a go, Launch Review will want the calibration story, so Fumiko's eval design should bake that in from the start. — Ivo
